listenings.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Global Retail Pricing Forum. My name is Rachel and I work with the conference team. The first session starts at nine thirty in the main hall, and the topic is price elasticity in food retail. Coffee is on the second floor, next to the registration desk. In the afternoon we have three parallel rooms, so please choose your session before lunch. If you need help, look for a person with a blue badge. We are here all day. Enjoy the forum.

Hello, this is David Cole from Kingsley Partners. I am calling about the Head of Pricing position we discussed by email. The client is a food retail group with stores in four countries, and they want to talk to you next week. The first interview is thirty minutes, by video, in English. They usually ask three things: what you do today, one result you are proud of, and why you want the role. Please send me two good times on Tuesday or Wednesday. Thank you, and have a good day.

extra_audio.text: Karen introduces herself and says she works for a grocery chain in Chicago. Marcio gives his name and says he is from Sao Paulo. He explains that he works in pricing at a wholesale company. Karen asks him how often he changes his prices. Marcio answers that he negotiates with every supplier before he decides.
